patch.summary: Zapier cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Zapier pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. 14-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.title: Zapier plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

lines.label: Free
lines.description: Free plan · Unlocks: LLM chat and assistants, writing and paraphrasing, agent / app builder · Suits: explore before committing seats

lines.label: Pro
lines.description: 14-day trial · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Team
lines.description: Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.heading: Zapier cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Zapier against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (enterprise admin and SSO (Free, Pro, Team)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (LLM chat and assistants, writing and paraphrasing, agent / app builder) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Task quotas (100 Free / 750 Pro) dominate TCO — multi-step Zaps burn tasks fast. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.
